name: Quick To Listen And Slow To Speak
overview: Scripture emphasizes the wisdom found in being quick to listen and slow to speak, highlighting restraint in speech as a mark of understanding and righteousness. Proverbs teaches that excessive words often lead to sin, while those who refrain from speaking hastily demonstrate true wisdom and understanding. The heart of the righteous carefully considers answers, and a gentle response can defuse anger, contrasting with the folly of stubbornness and harsh words. Moreover, controlling one's spirit and anger is portrayed as a greater strength than physical might, underscoring the value of patience and thoughtful speech in the believer's life.
